Three changes on every version

  1. The description now shows on phones. In Round 1 it was hidden below 768px, so Meta traffic only ever saw the headline.
  2. One line under every button. Not a broker · Buyers pay our fee · No obligation.
  3. Prefer email first? A checkbox on the last step. It tags the lead as email first and changes Alia's line. Setting emailFirst to false at the top of the page script turns it off.

Putting it in Webflow

Three embeds changed on each page: the hero headline, the lead form and the page script. The Webflow update kit has each one with a copy button. Every Round 1 link keeps working.
